decisions.decision: Show a collapsible procurement task rail beside the chat on desktop, and as a dismissible drawer on smaller screens. Use the existing colored mascot plus a small working GIF during active runs.

Keep the collapsed desktop navigation as a 64px icon rail with accessible labels and tooltips. Show sandbox status as labelled text without a decorative pointer or dot. Keep navigation and procurement context as independent panels, and as mutually exclusive drawers on small screens.
